name: Spiced Honey Crisp Apple & Dried Fig Red Wine Sangria

ingredients.name: light-bodied red wine (such as pinot noir)
four fruit preserves (cherry, strawberry, current & raspberry)

instructions.primary_message: Place 2 fl oz (1/4 cup) brandy, fruit preserves, cinnamon sticks, and star anise in a large pitcher. Using a long stirring spoon, muddle the mixture until combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
59 ml brandy
2 tbsp four fruit preserves (cherry, strawberry, current & raspberry)
2 star anise, whole

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; small dice. Add to the pitcher.
Trim figs, then halve or quarter lengthwise (depending on size). Add to the pitcher.

Slowly pour wine into the pitcher (so it doesn't splash), then gently stir to combine. Cover with a lid or piece of plastic wrap and refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours (or up to overnight for best results).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (750 ml) bottle light-bodied red wine (such as pinot noir)

instructions.primary_message: When ready to serve, add sparkling orange beverage to the pitcher and stir to combine the sangria (making sure to scrape up any fruit preserves that fell to the bottom). Fill wine glasses with ice (if desired) and slowly pour sangria over top, allowing fruit to fall into the glasses. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 330 ml sparkling orange beverage, lightly sweetened
